about.title: About
about.heading: Microboat
about.intro: I use this site to make engineering judgment visible: the tradeoffs behind tools, the failure modes behind systems, and notes that keep growing with experience.
paragraphs: This site is not a resume and not a chronological diary. It is a public engineering knowledge system for AI toolchains, infrastructure, developer experience, organizational learning, and long-lived system design.

I care more about why a design holds than which technology was used. A post that only records a conclusion expires quickly; a post that records the path of judgment can remain useful when the next similar problem appears.
If this is your first visit, start with Start Here. If you are researching a topic, follow topics, concepts, backlinks, and the local graph. The site runs on Next.js, MDX, and Cloudflare Workers.
